attempts.summary: Configured node1 to run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15 via root's crontab, appending output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. The script file was found broken (contained literal heredoc/setup text instead of executable content) and was rewritten to its intended form and made executable. busybox crond was stopped/not enabled — it was added to the default runlevel and started. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured a healthy baseline (boot_id, crond status, cron entry, script perms, log content), performed a native reboot via a backgrounded delayed `reboot` so the ack returned before disconnection, polled until the node was reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving a real restart, not just an enabled-service check), and verified crond auto-started at boot, the cron entry and script persisted, the log file persisted, and the maintenance script still runs and appends correctly.
